## Current legal state

Identify the relevant accepted provisions, or state that none exist.

## Problem

Describe the concrete defect, ambiguity, gap or conflict. Do not begin with proposed wording.

## Why it matters

Identify affected interests and plausible consequences.

## Assumptions and uncertainty

Distinguish facts, assumptions, inferences, normative choices and unknowns where relevant.

## Relevant cases or sources

Link only material that was actually checked. State what each source supports.

## Scope boundary

What should a proposal address, and what should remain outside this Issue?

## Authorship disclosure

State any material AI involvement and the human role.
